description: The Todos window opens the folder the shell handed it with the page's own engine through the folder plugin, and listens for the plugin's change event, epicenter-folder://changed. The shell registered that folder for this window alone; the page names no path. The page holds the window's close until what is typed saved, then destroys its own window (core:window:allow-destroy). It reads the app's identifier (core:app:allow-identifier) to offer Open in Epicenter only in standalone Todos, and asks the shell to open Epicenter on the folder the window was granted (open_in_epicenter); the shell, not the page, names that directory and opens the link.
